B03: over there where your family live

legos.why: PATTERN C. The taught side itself skips words of the seed, so the LEGO is not a piece of its seed (L32; L26 'a LEGO may contain only words its own seed says'). Re-cut to contiguous pieces of the seed. POV pass: here the ENGLISH has the hole ('where … live'). L32: 'teach the middle pieces first, then … the whole thing (frame + middle) as one LEGO'. The middle 'your family' is S0614L01, taught just before, so this becomes 'where your family live' (5 syllables). All four use rows already say exactly that.
